briefdescription.para: TAOPT-01: Normal inputs must produce a finite positive cost.

detaileddescription.para: TAOPT-02: All known function names must produce finite results for extreme-but-representable size_t inputs.

briefdescription.para: TAOPT-03: Zero inputs fall back to default dimension values (no div-by-zero).

detaileddescription.para: TAOPT-04: O(d·n·r³) path (TENSOR_SIMILARITY) is more expensive than O(d·n·r²) path (TENSOR_SLICE) for r > 1.

briefdescription.para: TAOPT-05: TENSOR_INFO (O(d·n)) produces the smallest cost for equal inputs.
QCANCEL-01: register + cancel + unregister round-trip succeeds.
QCANCEL-02: cancel() returns false for an unknown request ID.

detaileddescription.para: QCANCEL-03: Multiple concurrent registrations and cancellations do not deadlock and complete within a generous timeout.

briefdescription.para: REWRT-01: applies() returns false for a plan without JOIN nodes.
REWRT-02: applies() returns true when a JOIN has both FILTER and SCAN children.
REWRT-03: apply() pushes FILTER into SCAN children and returns change count 1.

detaileddescription.para: REWRT-04: Multiple FILTER nodes are all pushed; non-SCAN, non-FILTER children are left in place.
